e and limit query params with defaults page=1 and limit=20.
  - limit is capped at 100.
  - Non-numeric or values < 1 for page/limit return 400 with { error: string }.
  - Response payload now uses { items, total, page, limit }.
  - Category filter continues to work with pagination.
- No other API behavior changed.

What I changed

- File updated: src/routes/items.ts
- New logic in handleListItems:
  - Parse and validate query.page and query.limit with sensible defaults.
  - Enforce limit cap at 100.
  - Filter items by category (if provided) via listItems({ category }).
  - Compute total as the length of the filtered list.
  - Slice the filtered list to produce the paginated items: items = filtered.slice(start, end).
  - Return { items, total, page, limit } with status 200.

Usage examples

- Default pagination, all categories (unchanged filter behavior):
  - GET /items
  - Response body: { items, total, page: 1, limit: 20 }

- With category filter and pagination:
  - GET /items?category=garden&page=2&limit=5
  - Response body: { items: [...], total: 15, page: 2, limit: 5 }

- Error cases:
  - GET /items?page=0 -> 400, { error: "invalid page" }
  - GET /items?limit=0 -> 400, { error: "invalid limit" }
  - GET /items?page=abc -> 400, { error: "invalid page" }

Notes

- Total reflects the number of matching items after applying the category filter, before pagination.
- If page exceeds the available pages, items will be an empty array while total and page/limit remain accurate.
